questions.question: How many singers do we have ?
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from singer

questions.question: Show name , country , age for all singers ordered by age from the oldest to the youngest .
questions.gold_sql: select name ,  country ,  age from singer order by age desc

questions.question: What is the average , minimum , and maximum age of all singers from France ?
questions.gold_sql: select avg(age) ,  min(age) ,  max(age) from singer where country  =  'france'

questions.question: Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer .
questions.gold_sql: select song_name ,  song_release_year from singer order by age limit 1

questions.question: What are all distinct countries where singers above age 20 are from ?
questions.gold_sql: select distinct country from singer where age  >  20

questions.question: Show all countries and the number of singers in each country .
questions.gold_sql: select country ,  count(*) from singer group by country

questions.question: List all song names by singers above the average age .
questions.gold_sql: select song_name from singer where age  >  (select avg(age) from singer)

questions.question: Show location and name for all stadiums with a capacity between 5000 and 10000 .
questions.gold_sql: select location ,  name from stadium where capacity between 5000 and 10000

questions.question: What is the maximum capacity and the average of all stadiums ?
questions.gold_sql: select max(capacity), average from stadium

questions.question: What is the average and maximum capacities for all stadiums ?
questions.gold_sql: select avg(capacity) ,  max(capacity) from stadium

questions.question: What is the name and capacity for the stadium with highest average attendance ?
questions.gold_sql: select name ,  capacity from stadium order by average desc limit 1

questions.question: How many concerts are there in year 2014 or 2015 ?
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from concert where year  =  2014 or year  =  2015

questions.question: Show the stadium name and the number of concerts in each stadium .
questions.gold_sql: select t2.name ,  count(*) from concert as t1 join stadium as t2 on t1.stadium_id  =  t2.stadium_id group by t1.stadium_id

questions.question: Show the stadium name and capacity with most number of concerts in year 2014 or after .
questions.gold_sql: select t2.name ,  t2.capacity from concert as t1 join stadium as t2 on t1.stadium_id  =  t2.stadium_id where t1.year  >=  2014 group by t2.stadium_id order by count(*) desc limit 1

questions.question: What is the name and capacity of the stadium with the most concerts after 2013 ?
questions.gold_sql: select t2.name ,  t2.capacity from concert as t1 join stadium as t2 on t1.stadium_id  =  t2.stadium_id where t1.year  >  2013 group by t2.stadium_id order by count(*) desc limit 1

questions.question: Which year has most number of concerts ?
questions.gold_sql: select year from concert group by year order by count(*) desc limit 1

questions.question: Show the stadium names without any concert .
questions.gold_sql: select name from stadium where stadium_id not in (select stadium_id from concert)

questions.question: Show countries where a singer above age 40 and a singer below 30 are from .
questions.gold_sql: select country from singer where age  >  40 intersect select country from singer where age  <  30

questions.question: Show names for all stadiums except for stadiums having a concert in year 2014 .
questions.gold_sql: select name from stadium except select t2.name from concert as t1 join stadium as t2 on t1.stadium_id  =  t2.stadium_id where t1.year  =  2014

questions.question: Show the name and theme for all concerts and the number of singers in each concert .
questions.gold_sql: select t2.concert_name ,  t2.theme ,  count(*) from singer_in_concert as t1 join concert as t2 on t1.concert_id  =  t2.concert_id group by t2.concert_id
